content.short: Tellor is a decentralized, permissionless oracle protocol enabling smart contracts on Mantle to request and receive any type of real-world data.
content.description: Tellor is a decentralized oracle protocol allowing smart contracts to request and receive any type of data from the real world through a network of staked data reporters who are incentivized to provide accurate information. Unlike curated oracle networks, Tellor is fully permissionless: any data type can be requested by creating a new query specification, making it ideal for niche data needs beyond standard price feeds. Tellor is deployed on Mantle for flexible, permissionless data access.
